text: {"memo": "As of March 31, 2025, Coca-Cola Co (KO) would have written its most recently completed fiscal year as 2024. In FY2024, the company reported net sales of $47.55 billion, up 1.7% from $46.55 billion in FY2023, though organic revenue rose 5.8%. Net income attributable to shareholders was $10.77 billion, or $3.03 per diluted share, versus $9.49 billion, or $2.86, in FY2023. FY2023 net sales were $45.75 billion, up 8.8% from $43.20 billion in FY2022, with net income of $9.49 billion and EPS of $2.86. FY2022 net sales were $43.20 billion, up 17.2% from $36.61 billion in FY2021, and net income was $9.77 billion, or $2.95 per share. FY2021 net sales were $36.61 billion, with net income of $7.75 billion and EPS of $2.28. Margins remained resilient, with FY2024 operating margin around 24%, though currency and weakness in some markets pressured results. Cash flow was strong, with operating cash flow exceeding $12 billion in FY2024. Growth was price-led rather than volume-driven, as beverage demand normalized after prior recovery. The business performed well versus expectations, but revenue growth slowed sharply from the post-pandemic recovery. View: KO remains a defensive cash-generative compounder, though multiple compression and softer demand warrant a Hold stance."}
